milo.advanced.doc: M2 advanced retrieval: one query translation and a schema-validated self-query with a safe fallback.

milo.agent_app.doc: The chat engine on LangChain's `create_agent`. It replaces the app's own loop for live answers.

milo.agent_arm.doc: The same tools run by LangChain's `create_agent`, to compare with the app's own loop (`milo.app.App`).

milo.app.doc: The app the kit's contract suite builds: `build_app(chat_model, embeddings, tools_backend) -> App`.

milo.auth_pages.doc: The sign-up, sign-in and user-list pages. Plain forms; the server checks everything.

milo.chunk.doc: Heading-aware chunking of the knowledge-base articles.

milo.embed.doc: Embedders: the same interface for an offline baseline and for the chosen live model.

milo.flows.doc: Turns the trace file into per-request flows and an overview. Reads only; nothing here calls a model or a database.

milo.index.doc: The vector index: Chroma, cosine distance, in memory. The embeddings are computed by the caller.

milo.kb_pages.doc: Pages that show the knowledge base: an index of the documents and one page per document.

milo.landing.doc: The MILO product page at the root address: what MILO is, how it works, the demo, and how to start.

milo.llm.doc: The model client: LangChain `ChatOpenAI` pointed at OpenRouter, behind the kit's `invoke(messages, tools)`.

milo.mcp_server.doc: MILO's six tools served as an MCP server (streamable HTTP), so other MCP clients can call them.

milo.metrics.doc: Retrieval metrics on one query at a time, with bootstrap confidence intervals over queries.

milo.page.doc: The MILO pages: the chat and the overview. One HTML document each, with its CSS and script.

milo.pgstore.doc: PostgreSQL implementation of the `Store` interface (schema `milo_v2`, see db/migrations/).

milo.serve.doc: Start the chat page. Choices come from the environment:

milo.shell.doc: The one header every MILO page uses, and the brand mark.

milo.status.doc: System status for the owner's monitor: database, models and spend. Reads only; never prints a secret.

milo.store.doc: The storage interface. The app and the tools keep their state here, never in their own attributes.

milo.summary.doc: The end-of-conversation summary: what MILO recorded, the estimate for each service area, and a proposed first spec.

milo.tools.doc: M3 tools: the specs come from data/tools.yaml; the handlers run in code, never in the model.

milo.types.doc: The data shapes of the kit's interface (contract/README.md). The kit's tests read these by attribute, so MILO keeps its own copies instead of importing the kit.

milo.users.doc: Accounts: password hashing and the user store (memory for tests and demos; PostgreSQL in the database store).

milo.web.doc: The MILO web app: landing page, accounts, the chat, the knowledge base, and the owner's overview.

scripts.build_kb.doc: Render the synthetic knowledge package into knowledge-base articles (M0).

scripts.check_project_data.doc: Check a project's data folder (M0 checkpoint). Standard library only. Offline.

scripts.create_admin.doc: Create the owner's account (role admin). Run once, from the terminal, with the database URL in the environment.

scripts.demo_server.doc: A throwaway demo server for recording the video: the real live model and embeddings, an in-memory store, and one demo customer account. Nothing here is saved; restarting the server clears it.

scripts.eval_advanced.doc: M2 A/B on the dev gold set, against the M1 baseline. Paired by question.

scripts.eval_agent_arm.doc: Compare the app's own tool loop with LangChain's create_agent on the same tool cases.

scripts.eval_attacks.doc: M4 attack evaluation: attack success rate (ASR) and false refusals on benign input, against the real app.

scripts.eval_hybrid.doc: Hybrid retrieval against dense-only on the held-out set, read once.

scripts.eval_retrieval.doc: M1 retrieval baseline on the dev gold set.

scripts.eval_tools.doc: M3 tool evaluation on data/tool_cases.jsonl: selection, parameters and over-eager calls.

scripts.make_answer_batch.doc: Build labeling batch 5: real MILO answers to dev questions, with the passages each answer was given.

scripts.make_judge_extra.doc: Second batch of judge items: owner-story headlines S11 to S20 (demo data), answered by the live app.

scripts.make_judge_sheet.doc: Builds the labelling sheet for the LLM judge: 30 answers from the live app, with their passages, for hand labels.

scripts.migrate.doc: Apply the SQL migrations in db/migrations/ in order. Reads MILO_DATABASE_URL from the environment or .env.

scripts.narrate_demo.doc: Narrate the demo recording: spoken lines, matching subtitles, and a quiet background, all timed to the screen.

scripts.reset_password.doc: Set a new password for an account from the terminal. For the owner, when the password is forgotten.

scripts.run_judge.doc: LLM judge for faithfulness and relevance, calibrated against the hand labels in evals/judge/labels.csv.

milo.advanced:retrieve.doc: Filtered search when the filter is valid; unfiltered search when it is missing, invalid, or returns nothing.

milo.advanced:self_query.doc: The filters a question implies, or None.

milo.advanced:validate_filters.doc: Accept only a dict with keys from ALLOWED_KEYS and values from the known enums. Anything else is rejected.

milo.agent_app:AgentApp._numbered_search.doc: The search tool: retrieves, numbers each passage once per answer, and returns the numbered passages.

milo.agent_arm:make_tools.doc: The six tools for one owner. `search` replaces the search_knowledge handler (the chat engine numbers the passages).

milo.agent_arm:run_agent.doc: One question through `create_agent`. Returns the answer, the calls made, and any calls waiting for approval.

milo.app:App._invoke.doc: The primary model with bounded retries, then the local fallback once. Re-raises if both fail.

milo.chunk:_cut.doc: Cut one long paragraph at sentence ends, repeating `overlap` characters between pieces.

milo.embed:LexicalEmbedder.doc: Hashed unigrams and bigrams, L2-normalised. Deterministic across runs (zlib.crc32, not hash()).

milo.embed:OpenRouterEmbedder.embed.doc: Embeds in batches of at most 100 texts, the provider's limit. The cap is checked before each batch.

milo.flows:read_flows.doc: This owner's most recent flows, newest first. Other owners' lines are skipped.

milo.index:Index.search.doc: Top-k as (chunk_id, text, score), best first. Score = 1 - cosine distance. `where` filters on metadata.

milo.kb_pages:document_json.doc: The full text of one document, for the viewer on the chat page. Same path check as the page.

milo.landing:_toc.doc: The section index at the right edge (wide screens only). It marks the section in view and links back to the top.

milo.llm:LangChainChat.doc: A LangChain chat model with the kit's interface and its price.

milo.llm:LocalOllamaChat.doc: The fallback model. It answers from the passages only: tools are not offered, so a fallback can never act.

milo.llm:live_agent_model.doc: The raw `ChatOpenAI` on OpenRouter for `create_agent`, with the same settings as `live_chat_model`.

milo.llm:live_chat_model.doc: `ChatOpenAI` on OpenRouter. Building it sends nothing; the first `invoke` does.

milo.llm:local_chat_model.doc: The fallback: a local Ollama model. No key, no spend.

milo.llm:openai_tool.doc: A tool spec in the function-calling shape the OpenRouter endpoint expects.

milo.llm:text_of.doc: The text of a message. Some providers (Anthropic among them) return a list of content blocks.

milo.llm:to_message.doc: Our role/content dicts as LangChain messages. Assistant tool calls and tool results keep their ids.

milo.mcp_server:<module>.doc: MILO's six tools served as an MCP server (streamable HTTP), so other MCP clients can call them.

milo.mcp_server:Approvals.doc: Owner approvals of destructive actions, kept on the server. Each approval covers one (owner, diagnosis) pair.

milo.mcp_server:set_current_user.doc: For in-memory tests and local runs without HTTP: the owner the calls are made for.

milo.metrics:mean_ci.doc: Mean with a percentile bootstrap 95% interval. Deterministic for a given seed.

milo.metrics:ndcg_at_k.doc: Binary relevance with one relevant chunk: DCG = 1 / log2(rank + 1); ideal DCG = 1.

milo.pgstore:PostgresStore.delete_owner.doc: Remove everything one owner has stored. Used by tests and by the owner-deletion request (not yet exposed).

milo.pgstore:PostgresUserStore.doc: Accounts in milo_v2.users. The same four methods as MemoryUserStore.

milo.store:MemoryStore.doc: Dictionaries in memory. Every read is keyed by the owner, so one owner never sees another's data.

milo.tools:Backend.doc: Holds each owner's facts and diagnoses in memory. Persistence is M4/M6's concern, not this milestone's.

milo.tools:Backend.attach_search.doc: The app gives the backend its retrieval, so search_knowledge uses the same index as the answers.

milo.tools:validate_args.doc: A message describing the first problem with the arguments, or None when they are valid.

milo.users:check_new_account.doc: A message describing the first problem with a sign-up, or None when it is acceptable.

milo.web:create_app.feedback.doc: One thumbs vote on an answer. Stores the rating, a reason from a fixed list and a hashed owner. No text.

milo.web:create_app.login_needed.doc: Decorator: a page redirects to sign-in; an API answers 401; a customer on an admin page gets 403.

scripts.build_kb:Writer.doc: Markdown with three rules: shared sentences are left out (they live in the method notes), a sentence already written in this article is not written again, and a heading appears only when something follows it.

scripts.build_kb:boilerplate.doc: Sentences of more than three words that appear in at least BOILERPLATE_MIN case families.

scripts.build_kb:load_families.doc: The 20 case families: case, playbook and blueprint of the same number.

scripts.build_kb:module_of.doc: Family number (01 to 20) to v2 module id.

scripts.eval_attacks:CachedEmbedder.doc: Embeds each text once. Every attack re-indexes the same knowledge base; without the cache the spend cap counts it again.

scripts.eval_attacks:RecordingBackend.doc: Records every tool that actually ran, with the owner it ran for.

scripts.eval_attacks:check.doc: True when the attack succeeded. Each rule comes from the attack's success_check in data/attacks.jsonl.

scripts.eval_retrieval:read_heldout_once.doc: The held-out rows. Read once: the read is logged, and a second read is refused.

scripts.eval_retrieval:split_rows.doc: The rows of one split. The test split is read once: every read is logged, and a second read is refused.

scripts.eval_tools:score.doc: strict: every expected argument equal, free text included. lenient: structured arguments only, and any evidence_text must be the owner's own words (a substring of the query, ignoring quotes and case).

scripts.narrate_demo:background.doc: A light, bright background: a major-key progression (C, G, Am, F) with plucked eighth notes. Quiet by design.

scripts.narrate_demo:mix_speech_and_back.doc: The speech at a steady level, the quiet background under it, one stereo WAV with headroom against clipping.

scripts.narrate_demo:synth.doc: Speak one line into a WAV file. Calm by default; only a line longer than its window is spoken a little faster.

scripts.narrate_demo:write_subtitles.doc: ASS subtitles: each cue is shown from the start of its speech to the end of it.
